messages:
Amina Khan: Kicking off pen-test intake for Q2 vendor (ACME). Need an RBAC/access plan for the readroom, KMS snapshot/export approach, and provisional retest slots. Vendor run planned next Thursday, so timeline is tight.
Liam Patel: Do we want ephemeral roles + presigned S3 instead of creating long-lived IAM for them? Prefer least privilege.
Sasha Chen: Ephemeral STS sessions + MFA + scoped KMS perms sounds right. Also we should enable audit-log export for the run so vendor can collect proofs.
Maria Gomez: Quick question — will the vendor need KMS decrypt or just signing/verifying of artifacts? If it's just signing we can avoid giving decrypt.
Amina Khan: Vendor says they need to pull logs and produce signed proofs; will confirm whether decrypt is required for staging archives. Maria, can you confirm with their PM?
deploy-bot: heads-up: scheduled maintenance 03:00 UTC tomorrow — staging unaffected but flagging for awareness.
Liam Patel: Proposal: create ephemeral role with session duration 4h, limit to prefix pt-readroom/* on S3 via presigned URLs, and grant kms:Decrypt only on alias/pt-staging if absolutely required.
Sasha Chen: Also add a log-sampler entry to capture 10% of relevant traffic and tag those entries with pt:vendor=acme so we can filter vendor proofs easily.
Maria Gomez: We should also formalize the retest flow: remediation PR -> evidence upload -> security triage signoff -> schedule retest slot. Can we use a ticket template for that?
Amina Khan: Yes — I'll draft a short Confluence template. For retest windows, propose next-Mon AM as provisional or two weeks after if fixes take longer. Who will own the remediation tracker?
Liam Patel: Security triage team owns the tracker; engineering squads attach PRs and ETAs. Use issue label pt-priority for visibility.
Sasha Chen: Important: plan to rotate the KMS key after the assessment and make sure rotation events are captured in audit logs (KMS:ScheduleKeyDeletion/RotateKey).
Maria Gomez: Vendor just replied: they only need GET access to artifacts + log exports, no DB dumps. We should refuse DB access unless we get a strong justification.
Amina Khan: Action items: Maria to confirm final key scopes with vendor; Liam to prepare ephemeral role + presigned S3; Sasha to add log sampling + set up audit export; I’ll prepare ticket template and lock retest window options. Please ping here when done.
Liam Patel: :thumbsup: I’ll create the role and post the IAM policy snippet here.
Sasha Chen: IAM snippet preview:
```
Role: pt-vendor-ephemeral
Allow: s3:GetObject on pt-readroom/*
Allow: kms:Decrypt on alias/pt-staging
Condition: aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent = true
```
Maria Gomez: Confirmed: vendor does not need DB exports. They only requested logs + artifacts.
Amina Khan: Provisional slot: Mon 09:00 UTC (1792110000) — tentative until roles/policies are in place. We’ll lock the slot once IAM + S3 + audit exports are verified.
deploy-bot: New audit export job created: export-pt-1792023456 (status: scheduled)
Sasha Chen: I’ll run a dry-run of the audit export and share the signed URL here for validation.
Liam Patel: Role created and policy published: https://internal/iam/policies/pt-vendor-ephemeral — added resource tag pt:vendor=acme.
Amina Khan: Thanks everyone. Please follow up in this thread when tasks are done. Recommend a short bridge on the day-of — assign ops point and security oncall. Closing for now.
